description: This file defines a final class 'Source' in the Twig namespace, representing information about a non-compiled Twig template, including its source code, name, and optional filesystem path.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: Represents information about a non-compiled Twig template, including source code, template name, and file path.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Source object with template code, name, and optional path.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the source code of the template.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path of the template, if any.
